item.title: Gov. Beshear announces $612K in new SAFE awards for Eastern Kentucky storm recovery - WTVQ
item.description: Gov. Andy Beshear announced more than $612,000 in new SAFE awards to support ongoing storm and flood recovery in Eastern Kentucky, including funding for Whitesburg, Perry County, Wheelwright and high-ground housing projects.

item.title: Lexington firefighter arrested on misdemeanor domestic violence charge - WTVQ
item.description: Lexington Firefighter Nicholas Baldwin was arrested in Jessamine County on a misdemeanor domestic violence charge and has been placed on paid administrative duty, according to a release from Battalion Chief Derek Roberts.

item.title: AAA warns drivers to use caution as wintry mix moves into Kentucky - WTVQ
item.description: AAA is urging drivers to use caution as a wintry mix of snow, sleet and freezing rain moves into Kentucky, warning that slick roads could impact the Tuesday morning commute. The agency shared winter driving reminders and safety tips.

item.title: A quick shot of wintry weather for parts of the area into Tuesday - WTVQ
item.description: A Winter Weather Advisory is out for all of Central Kentucky into Tuesday morning so expect a slick morning commute in spots.

item.title: Lexington prepares for winter weather with expanded snow fleet and added staffing - WTVQ
item.description: Lexington officials say the city is ready for Monday night’s winter weather, with expanded snow crews, new equipment, and overnight pre-treating efforts. Drivers are urged to use caution as crews prepare to work through the night.
